scenes.title: The boat at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them to the old chapel for two silver, but never at night. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, with warm water, and offers a ride at first light tomorrow.

scenes.title: Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The mine tunnel is flooded with warm black water, with wet hymn-book pages floating on it. A page is marked in pencil "M. Brand", which Teo recognises as his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya speculate that harbor-master Maren is in the cult. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The bell at midnight
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel ruins
scenes.summary: At dusk the party goes to the shore despite Sela's warning, and fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is louder than two nights ago, and pale congregation-like shapes stand on the chapel floor. The party flees.

scenes.title: Stew and a plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull tavern, Gullwick docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide tomorrow, with Sela rowing at first light. Innkeeper Bram speaks well of Maren, who lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest.
